scope: Additive audit of permanent Home Village Pet L.A.S.S.I L1-15 and its attachment to an included Hero. This delta enables no partial proxy actor.
game_version: The secondary level table reports client build 18.400.21; the pinned raw payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. No checked source supplies a complete current Pet AI or collision build contract.

sources.title: Full Patch Notes (Town Hall 14 Update)
sources.levels: Pet House 1 onward; current numerical levels not listed
facts: One available Pet may accompany a Hero.
L.A.S.S.I attacks ground targets with single-target damage, prefers targets within 2.5 tiles of her paired Hero, moves at public speed 32 and can jump Walls.
sources.limitations: It does not specify deployment offset or tick, follow distance, target priority within the preferred area, target-loss and retargeting, jump collision or duration, post-Hero-death behavior, or combat event ordering.

sources.title: L.A.S.S.I
sources.version: client build 18.400.21, as reported by publisher
facts: The visible L1-15 hitpoint and DPS table agrees with the pinned raw payload; it labels 0.6-tile range and ground targeting.
sources.limitations: The page predates the reported 18.600.3 build and does not publish full following or target-loss rules, per-level impact cadence, exact jump timing or collision.

sources.title: L.A.S.S.I
facts: The page claims L.A.S.S.I attacks the nearest building after her Hero is knocked out or recalled.
sources.limitations: The claim lacks a reproducible current capture and does not define detection, priority, retargeting or tick ordering. It is retained only as a research lead.

derivations.result: Raw damagePerHit is 0.9 times raw damagePerSecond at each pinned level
derivations.method: Compare per-level fields in the immutable raw payload; this arithmetic corroborates its recorded 0.9-second cadence but does not establish launch phase or current-build fidelity.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn L.A.S.S.I at the Hero's exact coordinate and tick.
rejected_inferences.reason: The official attachment statement has no spawn offset, collision or same-tick order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Pick the lowest-entity-ID target within 2.5 tiles of the Hero as the complete Pet AI.
rejected_inferences.reason: The official favorite-target phrase omits first acquisition, priority, target lock and fallback rules.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use generic troop movement and instant Wall bypass as verified High Jumper geometry.
rejected_inferences.reason: Wall-jump timing, collision and destination are absent; generic movement would be an approximation.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the Fandom post-Hero-death sentence as a complete current rule.
rejected_inferences.reason: No client version or deterministic acquisition and retargeting contract accompanies it.

items: follow, acquisition, pursuit, target-loss and post-Hero-death behavior
same-tick damage, death and retarget ordering
battlefield sprite, anchor and redistribution rights

conclusion: L.A.S.S.I L1-15 remains a catalogued, partial Pet. Public evidence confirms its identity and high-level targeting and Wall-jump behavior but not a deterministic complete paired-Pet lifecycle. No Core, Headless, Viewer, RL, snapshot or replay behavior is claimed.
